scientific_sign_off.approval_record: Explicit owner approval received in the project conversation; approver name was not provided.
scientific_sign_off.approved_scope: Canonical production scope represented by the N9 acceptance plan and the pinned ETNA and ETNA_LAVA evidence; no broader universal model or compiler-coverage claim.
scientific_sign_off.comparison_policy: Retain existing scientific field and identity limits; require exact equality for the recorded same-build restart and actual one/four-thread comparisons. No solver tolerance or new residual threshold is introduced.

budget_policy.ETNA: Evaluate the recorded full-run budget over 0-200 s.
budget_policy.ETNA_LAVA: Evaluate the mass budget only through the last saved output before boundary contact, at 3180 s. The first saved output with positive boundary depth is 3240 s; exact first-contact time is unknown at the 60 s output cadence. Full-field and restart checks continue through 3600 s.

scientific_sign_off.raw_output_retention: Bulky raw run payloads are not required to be retained. The versioned manifest retains the recorded source, executable, input, output, checkpoint, snapshot and log checksums and run metadata.
